issues.limit.tools: The plan has {count} tools; a plan can hold {max}.
issues.limit.cases: The plan has {count} cases; it can hold {max}. Remove some cases.
issues.limit.fixtures: The plan has {count} fixtures; it can hold {max}. Remove some fixtures.
issues.limit.cleanup: The plan has {count} cleanup steps; it can hold {max}. Remove some steps.
issues.limit.id: The id "{id}" must be 1 to {max} characters. Rename it.
issues.limit.plan: The plan is over {max} characters of JSON. Remove cases or shorten their arguments.
issues.limit.maxCalls: The call budget must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
issues.limit.concurrency: Concurrency must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
issues.limit.callTimeout: The call timeout must be a whole number of milliseconds from {min} to {max}.
issues.duplicate.tool: {tool} is in the plan twice. Keep one entry for it.
issues.duplicate.case: Two cases have the id {caseId}. Give each case its own id.
issues.duplicate.fixture: Two fixtures have the id {fixture}. Rename one of them.
issues.unknownTool: The server does not list {tool}. Remove it from the plan.
issues.unknownTool.case: Case {caseId} calls {tool}, which is not in the plan. Add the tool, or remove the case.
issues.missingTool: {tool} is not in the plan. Add a case for it, or exclude it with a reason.
issues.lessCautious: The server marks {tool} as {declared}, so the plan cannot treat it as {planned}. Set it to {declared}.
issues.exclusion.reason: {tool} is excluded without a reason. Choose a reason.
issues.exclusion.note: {tool} is excluded for another reason. Say which in a note.
issues.actionCases.excluded: {tool} is excluded but has cases. Remove its cases, or include the tool.
issues.actionCases.noValid: {tool} has no valid-input case. Add one, or plan the tool as negative only.
issues.actionCases.noNegative: {tool} is negative only and has no negative case. Add one.
issues.argumentsMissing: Case {caseId} has no arguments yet. Draft or enter them.
issues.writeScope.missing: {tool} can change data and names no fixture it may change. Name its fixtures, or exclude it.
issues.writeScope.creates: Case {caseId} creates {fixture}, which {tool} may not write. Add {fixture} to its permitted writes.
issues.unknownFixture: {where} names the fixture {fixture}, which the plan does not declare. Declare it, or correct the name.
issues.unknownFixture.value: {where} uses the value "{value}" of {fixture}, which that fixture does not provide. Add it to the fixture, or correct the reference.
issues.fixtureCreation.none: Nothing in the plan creates {fixture}. Add a case that creates it, or mark it existing.
issues.fixtureCreation.twice: More than one case creates {fixture}. Keep one.
issues.fixtureCreation.existing: {fixture} is already in the reviewer's account, so case {caseId} cannot create it. Mark the fixture created, or remove it from the case.
issues.order.created: Case {caseId} uses {fixture} before case {creator} creates it. Move it after that case.
issues.order.destructive: Case {caseId} can destroy data and runs before case {later}. Move destructive cases to the end.
issues.cleanup.missing: {fixture} is created by the plan and never removed. Add a cleanup step for it.
issues.cleanup.existing: {fixture} was in the reviewer's account before the sweep, so cleanup must not remove it. Remove the step.
issues.cleanup.tool: Cleanup calls {tool}, which the plan does not run. Use a tool the plan includes.
issues.writeScope.cleanup: Cleanup for {fixture} must reference that fixture and may only target fixtures created by this run. Correct its arguments.
issues.writeScope.target: {tool} can delete data but names no target fixture. Use a permitted fixture reference, or exclude the case.
issues.writeScope.reference: {tool} uses {fixture} outside its permitted writes. Correct the arguments or authorize that fixture.

cases.ambiguous: The call started and did not finish, so it may have changed data. Check what it changed, then record what happened or rerun it.
cases.staleAccount: It ran as another reviewer account. Run it again.
cases.staleNoAccount: It ran with no account, and tests now run as the reviewer account. Run it again.
cases.staleSignedIn: It ran as a reviewer account, and the submission now says the server needs no sign-in. Run it again.
cases.staleInputs: The case, a fixture it uses or the tool's schema changed after it ran. Run it again.
cases.running: The call has not finished. A read that stopped runs again when the sweep resumes.
cases.refused: The server refused the call before the tool ran. Check the reviewer's sign-in and permissions, then run it again.
cases.unreachable: The server did not answer. Check that it is reachable, then run it again.
cases.acceptedInvalid: The tool accepted input it should refuse.
cases.notDrafted: Its arguments are not drafted yet. Draft or enter them.
cases.fixtureMissing: {fixture} was not found in the reviewer's account. Add it there, or update the fixture.
cases.notCaptured: Case {creator} returned no {value} for {fixture}. Correct the fixture's capture path, then run again.
cases.budget: The sweep used its call budget before this case. Raise the budget and run again.
cases.deadline: The run reached its time limit before this case. Run again to continue.
cases.cancelled: The run was cancelled before this case.
cases.setup: The run stopped on a setup problem before this case. Fix it and run again.

answers.refused: a refusal before the tool ran
